title: Gameplay Content Document v1
description: Editor and documentation support only for the packaged gameplay content document read by GameplayContentReader / JsonDefinitionCatalogBuilder. The C# reader is the sole runtime enforcement authority; this schema is a precise reference for human and AI editors and is checked for agreement with the reader's constants and with docs/content/json-content-pipeline.md by an Edit Mode consistency test. See specs/002-json-content-authoring/contracts/gameplay-content-v1.md (normative).

contentSchemaVersion.description: Content contract version, independent of the Save V1 checkpoint schemaVersion. Read first; an unsupported value rejects the document before anything else is interpreted.

offlinePolicies.description: Offline policy definitions, keyed by revision. The catalog currently accepts exactly one entry: revision 1 with efficiencyNumerator 4, efficiencyDenominator 5, maxCreditedTicks 288000000000 (policy.revision-1.required otherwise).

id.description: Stable identifier. 1-128 UTF-16 code units, unchanged by trim + Unicode NFC, compared by case-sensitive ordinal equality, unique within its family. Never derived from a label, file name, or asset path.

label.description: Non-blank display text, not an ID. No normalization or cross-entry uniqueness rule.

presentationKey.description: Key into F001SpriteCatalog. When present it must resolve there, or start-up fails with presentation.key.unresolved.

amount.description: Whole resource units. Must be positive.

capacity.description: Whole resource units the buffer can hold.

id.description: Stable resource ID. This is the save identity referenced by Save V1.

presentationKey.description: Optional. ResourceDefinition accepts a null presentation key (DefinitionGuard.OptionalText).

inputs.description: Resources consumed per craft. resourceId must be unique within this array.

outputs.description: Resources produced per craft. resourceId must be unique within this array.

durationTicks.description: Craft duration in 100 ns ticks (50000000 = 5 s). Must be positive.

footprintWidth.description: Footprint width in grid cells. Must be positive.

footprintHeight.description: Footprint height in grid cells. Must be positive.

allowedOrientations.description: Quarter turns the building may be placed at, each 0-3, each unique.

recipeId.description: Optional. Must match a declared recipes[].id. A building with recipeId is a producing building and requires both inputBuffer and outputBuffer.

inputBuffer.description: Optional. Omitted means no input buffer. When present, resourceId is unique within the array, and every input resource of the referenced recipe must be declared here.

outputBuffer.description: Optional. Omitted means no output buffer. When present, resourceId is unique within the array, and every output resource of the referenced recipe must be declared here.

presentationKey.description: Required. BuildingDefinition requires a non-blank presentation key (DefinitionGuard.RequiredText) — unlike resources, there is no optional overload. Omitting it produces member.missing.

revision.description: Offline policy revision, referenced by Save V1. Unique across offlinePolicies. Must be positive.

efficiencyNumerator.description: Offline efficiency ratio numerator. Must be positive and strictly less than efficiencyDenominator.

efficiencyDenominator.description: Offline efficiency ratio denominator. Must be positive.

maxCreditedTicks.description: Credited offline cap in 100 ns ticks (288000000000 = 8 h). Must be positive.
